title: Skill Sync Split-Brain — Dated History (T3 ref)
desc: Dated incident archive for skill-sync-split-brain-cleanup: audit findings, the confirmed sync/install false-success bug, and the prototype build/delete history, split out to keep the T1 core score above the delegation-gate threshold.
steps: AUDIT 2026-05-30/2026-06-03: skills/wkappbot-workflow/skill-sync-{split-brain-cleanup,warning-triage}.skill.json self-references and peer refs went stale/broken after skills became catalog-only (not file-tracked).

BUG (confirmed 2026-07-09, Opus ROOT, suggest ts=2026-07-08T18:49:41): wkappbot skill sync --resolve <id> and skill install <path> both report SUCCESS but do not actually propagate fork content into the HQ install copy -- sync --resolve prints resolved split-brain while HQ stays unchanged, install prints nothing and HQ is untouched. Root cause of the persistent 300-400+ CONFLICTS count that never shrinks. This is the reason the read-time lazy dedup design exists -- it routes around this broken propagation path instead of depending on it.

CONFIRMED 2026-07-09 (Sonnet follow-up): a full build's skill-install step only handles brand-new skills, does not overwrite an existing HQ skill whose version is already >= the fork's -- the build-flush path is a separate, still-partially-broken problem from the per-edit propagation gap.

PROTOTYPE HISTORY 2026-07-25: first prototype (SkillReadDedup-haiku-proto.cs) built by Haiku, ROOT-verified (byte-for-byte write-verify-before-delete, real captured stdout-stderr separation test, real fabricated fixtures), then deleted per proto-cleanup-discipline once its logic was captured here -- design later simplified by the user to drop the HQ-write branch entirely (see core skill's DESIGN FINALIZED step), so a second solid implementation was commissioned against the simpler 3-branch (no-op / identical-delete / stale-delete / newer-warn-only) spec.
